data.notes: December in Melbourne/Naarm is heavy on summer festival season and electronic day-to-night programming, with major camping festivals just outside the city and strong warehouse, beach-club, and NYE lineups in town.

events.title: Beyond The Valley 2026
events.summary: Beyond The Valley’s 2026 edition runs over New Year’s at Barunah Plains with John Summit, Black Eyed Peas, Skepta, Ocean Alley, KI/KI, Job Jobse, Nia Archives, Armand Van Helden, DJ PGZ and many more across its stages.

events.title: Meredith 34
events.summary: Meredith 34 runs 11–13 December at the Meredith Supernatural Amphitheatre, with Dijon, underscores, Fcukers, The Dandy Warhols, Hiatus Kaiyote, DJ Seinfeld, Marcellus Pittman and Eddy Current Suppression Ring among the confirmed lineup.

events.title: Good Things Festival 2026 - Melbourne
events.summary: Australia’s touring heavy/alternative festival returns to Melbourne with Limp Bizkit, Simple Plan, Spiritbox, Polaris, The All-American Rejects, Bad Religion, Alexisonfire, Grinspoon, Millencolin and more confirmed on the 2026 lineup.

events.title: New Year’s At The Bowl 2026
events.venueName: Sidney Myer Music Bowl and Kings Domain Gardens
events.summary: New Year’s At The Bowl returns to central Melbourne for NYE with three stages and a lineup led by Major Lazer, Don West, DJ Seinfeld, Flight Facilities, CC:DISCO!, Helena Hauff and Todd Terje.

events.title: Charlotte de Witte - Australia 2026
events.summary: Charlotte de Witte headlines The Wool Store in West Footscray for a Melbourne warehouse date on her Australia 2026 run.

events.title: Defected Melbourne 2026
events.summary: Defected returns to Melbourne at Northcote Theatre with Sam Divine, Nick Curly, Murphy’s Law and David Penn as part of its late-November/December Australasia tour.

events.title: ZURI Festival Melbourne
events.venueName: PICA (Port Melbourne Industrial Centre for the Arts)
events.summary: ZURI Festival brings Mahmut Orhan, Francis Mercier, Marten Lou, Maison Ware and Rromarin to PICA for a warehouse-scale house and afro-house festival experience.

events.title: Anjunadeep Melbourne
events.venueName: PICA (Port Melbourne Industrial Centre for the Arts)
events.summary: Anjunadeep takes over PICA with Eli & Fur, Dosem b2b HANA, Jody Wisternoff b2b Rezident, Catching Flies and Mike Rish.

events.title: James Blake: Trying Times Australia Tour
events.summary: James Blake returns to Melbourne for the Trying Times Australia Tour at Margaret Court Arena, following his 2026 album of the same name.

events.title: The Jamaica Music and Food - 10th Anniversary
events.summary: The 10th-anniversary Jamaican Music & Food Festival takes over Seaworks with reggae, dancehall, rocksteady and ska across multiple stages.

events.title: I Hate Models - Open Air
events.summary: I Hate Models plays an Australian-exclusive open-air Melbourne show with a four-hour set in Elwood, promoted by Live Nation Australia.

events.title: VTSS Melbourne
events.summary: Novel presents VTSS in an industrial Preston warehouse setting, billed as a full-scale electronic show with raw production and dancefloor energy.

events.title: Baby Keem: The Ca$ino Tour
events.summary: Baby Keem brings The Ca$ino Tour to Festival Hall Melbourne for a major hip-hop arena-room date.

events.title: TEKNO & FRIENDS LIVE IN MELBOURNE
events.summary: Afrobeats star Tekno brings a diaspora-focused live show to The Timber Yard, with the listing also tagging afrohouse and amapiano.

events.title: Pegassi - Australia 2026
events.summary: Untitled Group brings Pegassi to The Wool Store for a Melbourne headline date built around fast, rave-nostalgic modern house energy.

events.title: Dizzee Rascal: We Want Bass Tour
events.venueName: Live At The Gardens, Royal Botanic Gardens Melbourne
events.summary: Dizzee Rascal brings his We Want Bass tour to Royal Botanic Gardens Melbourne with Example, ArrDee and Swaglord Savannah on the bill.

events.title: Sundrift x Club Dabke pres. DJ Habibeats + CHAMOS + Special K
events.summary: Sundrift and Club Dabke link for a Riviera Beach Club day party with DJ Habibeats, CHAMOS, Special K, Bouncy, MzRizk and Mowgli.

events.title: Black Mass
events.summary: Black Mass is a Berlin-inspired goth and hard-techno multi-level club night with a basement techno room, performances and a strict alternative dress code.

events.title: Joost Klein - World Tour
events.summary: Dutch artist Joost Klein brings his World Tour to Festival Hall Melbourne on Wednesday 2 December 2026. Ticketmaster and the Festival Hall venue listing confirm the 7:00pm event time.

events.title: Harry Styles: Together, Together
events.summary: Harry Styles’ global stadium residency run includes a confirmed Melbourne date at Marvel Stadium on Wednesday 2 December 2026. The official Marvel Stadium announcement lists this as the added third Melbourne show.

events.title: Live at the Gardens - Wolf Alice
events.summary: Wolf Alice headline Live at the Gardens at Royal Botanic Gardens Melbourne on Saturday 5 December 2026. The official event page confirms the one-night Melbourne performance and gates at 5:00pm.

events.title: A Perfect Circle with Puscifer
events.summary: A Perfect Circle return to Melbourne for a Rod Laver Arena show on Sunday 6 December 2026, with Puscifer listed as special guest. The official venue page confirms the 6:45pm start time.

events.title: Ministry of Sound Melbourne 2026
events.summary: Ministry of Sound returns to Sidney Myer Music Bowl on Friday 11 December 2026 for an 18+ summer dance festival. Moshtix lists Ministry of Sound Classical Orchestra, international headliners, Australian electronic pioneers, local talent, and three stages.

events.title: Guns N' Roses: World Tour 2026 with Airbourne
events.summary: Guns N’ Roses play Marvel Stadium in Melbourne on Friday 11 December 2026 as part of their World Tour 2026. Live Nation lists Airbourne on the lineup for the Melbourne stadium date.
